evals.name: Simple Spanish greeting
evals.expected_output: A warm response containing greetings in three distinct languages followed by a brief, friendly offer to help

assertions.text: The response contains greeting phrases in three distinct languages
The response writes only the greeting phrase on each line, without prefixing or labeling the language name (e.g. no 'Español:', 'Inglés:', 'French:')
The response includes a brief follow-up offer of help (e.g. a short question asking what the user needs)
The response does not include unrelated filler content beyond the greeting and the offer to help

evals.name: Informal English greeting
evals.expected_output: A casual response with greetings in three distinct languages matching the informal register, plus a brief friendly offer to help

assertions.text: The response contains greeting phrases in exactly three distinct languages
The greetings use an informal/casual register matching the user's informal 'hey'
Each line in the greeting block contains only a greeting phrase without a language label
The response ends with a short, casual offer to help

evals.name: Greeting in a less common language
evals.expected_output: A response that recognizes the German greeting, includes German as one of the three languages, and offers help

assertions.text: The response contains greeting phrases in three distinct languages
One of the three greetings is in German, acknowledging the language the user used
The three greetings are in three different languages (no two in the same language)
The response includes a brief follow-up offer of help after the greetings
